The '''Guardian of Dark History''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] guardian of the [[Annals of Dark History]] located underneath the [[Old Paths]] on [[Voss]]. It was destroyed by an Imperial who had breached the archives.<ref name="TOR" />
